anchor: bottom center, feet end at row 53
body_note: left, top, right, bottom of the rabbit in idle frame 0, rim included, right and bottom exclusive

idle.notes: Ear twitch, then a one pixel breath. head_dy tells the renderer how far to push overlays down per frame.

listening.notes: Ears stretch up, eyes widen. Hold the last frame while the kid talks.

thinking.notes: He glances at his watch while a pocket watch ticks in a thought bubble. Loop while the model works.

aha.notes: The watch turns into a light bulb and the bubble pops. Play once when the answer is ready, then idle.

confused.notes: One ear flops over and a question mark bobs.

celebrate.notes: A hop with happy eyes and sparkles, landing with a squash. Play once.

wave.notes: He waves with his ear. Use for greetings.

sleepy.notes: Both ears flopped, eyes shut, z's rising. Bedtime and session limits.

dragged.notes: Startled and swinging while the kid drags him.

hole_only.notes: An empty rabbit hole opening. Reverse it to close.

hole_open.notes: The hole opens under his feet. Reverse it to close once he has popped out.

dive.notes: He drops into the hole. Reverse it to pop out on the other screen.

hole_wait.notes: Ears poking out of the hole. Loop while the handoff completes.

overlay_blink.notes: Eye patch: half, closed, half. Draw over idle, offset by head_dy.

overlay_mouth.notes: Mouth patch: 0 flat, 1 open, 2 wide, 3 smile. Pick by voice loudness. Offset by head_dy.
